caption: The drawing features a single rooster positioned in the center of a plain, light beige background. The rooster is depicted in profile, facing left, with its head lowered as if pecking at the ground. Its head and comb are bright red, the beak is yellow, and the eye is highlighted. The rooster's neck and part of its back are colored a golden yellow with orange and white accents, while the wings have a light blue hue with some orange and white detail. The tail feathers are dark with hints of green and blue. The legs and feet of the rooster are light brown with yellowish tones. There are no additional objects or features in the drawing apart from the rooster, and the artist's name, "Lillian R. Hunter," is faintly inscribed in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Toy Rooster
